blocks.html: No GPS signal? Take bearings to two or more known landmarks and ATAK works out where you are.

slides.title: Open the Resection Tool
slides.html: Open the Resection Tool. The panel lists each landmark with its Location and Bearing, plus an empty Intersection field at the bottom.

slides.title: Drop a landmark and set its bearing
slides.html: Stand still, face a landmark you can see on the map, and tap the point dropper icon to place it. A compass appears so you can adjust the bearing from your position to that landmark.

slides.title: Plot the intersection
slides.html: Place two or more landmarks. Then tap the Plot Intersection icon to drop a marker at the computed intersection. The marker is labelled with your device callsign.

slides.title: Move, delete, or clear landmarks
slides.html:
• To move a point, long-press it on the map and pick a new spot.
  • To remove one point, tap it on the map and select Delete.
  • To remove them all, tap the Clear Landmarks icon and confirm.

slides.title: Update your position and exit
slides.html: Tap Back to exit. When asked to update your location, select Yes to move your Self-Marker to the estimate and broadcast it, or No to leave it.
